title: cse-progress complexity analyzer contract
description: The Big-O analyzer's Python modules, emitted by scripts/export_complexity.py for the progressiveoverflow.com practice page. The site writes each module's source to <name>.py on the Pyodide path, then imports complexity_infer and grades the learner's labels against infer() on the code they ran. The label pool is not carried here: the site reads it from big-o.json's `pool`. schemaVersion is bumped on any breaking change.

modules.description: Every scripts/complexity_*.py except complexity_corpus, sorted by name.
